Jack Owusu
jack.owusu@example.com | Chicago, IL
Jack Owusu has 11 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Silverline Platform (2023-2026), where they
led migration of core services at Silverline Platform onto Terraform, improving
uptime during peak load. Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Palodex
Solutions (2021-2023). Before that, Backend Engineer at Silverline Analytics
(2019-2021). Before that, Software Engineer I at Hollowbrook Software
(2015-2019). Education: Ph.D. Information Systems, UC San Diego, 2015; B.S.
Information Systems, University of Cincinnati, 2010. Core skills: TypeScript,
Redis, Go, Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS, PostgreSQL, Distributed systems, Node.js,
gRPC, REST API design, Terraform.
